changelog: Agent reliability fixes: SCM recovery timing (60s/120s/60s with 5min reset), tighter health thresholds (5 crashes/min, 200MB memory, 5min window), reconnection backoff with full jitter, watchdog isAgentResponding via agent-info.json freshness check (90s), and orphan agent escalating backoff after 3 failed NeedsEnrollment attempts.
